verdict.rationale: Sift produces a 0–100 risk score and offers Workflows, a rules automation platform for real-time risk-based decisions. It also has Review Queues and custom Decisions (e.g., Ban Account, Cancel Order) tied to backend actions. Together these imply score-driven routing to allow, review, and block outcomes, but the evidence never explicitly shows configuring score-range thresholds or a step-up 3DS action. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of score-threshold configuration in Workflows, a step-up 3DS/authentication action, and hands-on corroboration of threshold tuning.
